Oriental's current site (orientalinsurance.org.in) is a React SPA that loads PDFs dynamically from oicl-cms-media S3 bucket — bucket listing forbidden, JS bundle has no hardcoded PDF URLs. Oriental PDFs sourced via Wayback Machine if_-proxy of legacy /documents/10182/* Liferay URLs (Dec 2023 / Feb-Apr 2024 captures), which are the last-known canonical wordings before the SPA redesign.
